== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Blue District is one of nine distinct sections within the city. It represents the virtue of mercy, a quality considered essential for [[Naraka Traveler|Naraka Travelers]] due to their judgmental nature. The district is characterized by its blue color scheme, which includes blue [[stone]] and cobblestones. Its [[inhabitants]] include various creatures such as three-tailed lizards, airborne ethereal fish, and unnamed tentacled beings that consume the heat and life force of [[Naraka]] monsters. The district contains the ruins of a [[Naraka waystation]] and is accessible through a specific door located within the city's dividing walls.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Blue District is the all-blue section of [[Enosh]]. After [[Alin]] mentions the area, he begins a march toward the location. This district is known to contain jellies within its bounds. Ultimately, an explosion occurs inside the Blue District.}}
